issue.title: Task-bead backlog, epic 2: fix the five most important open task beads
issue.description: The five most important workable task beads in the sase project are resolved on master and closed with recorded evidence: sase-1og (the check-full flake-baseline gate exits 2 before judging anything), sase-18t (ToolRun store "database is locked" under parallel load), sase-1a7 (the Files ctrl+j anchor-scroll node that keeps Full CI red), sase-12f (the monitor-capacity fakey e2e that exits 124 under load), and sase-1ot (owner-approved rotation and purge of 27 historical secret-scanner hits in public sase--agents history). The land agent then starts the next backlog epic, five beads at a time, until no workable task bead remains.
